script_chunks.text: THEY SAY MEN MOVE WITH CLARITY.

voiceover_text: I'm a Brad-in-finance apologist. They say men move with clarity. Brad's running a hedge fund. Eighteen-hour days. Three time zones. His texts are... concise. A single 'K' is love. He's not dragging his feet. He's making our millions.
caption: Brad's not ignoring you, he's allocating. The K means yes. The silence means strategy. My peace is not negotiable.
